There are a total of 72 [[mosques]] in [[Singapore]]. Almost all of the mosques in Singapore are administered by the local Islamic council, the [[Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura]] (MUIS), with the exception of [[Masjid Temenggong Daeng Ibrahim]], [[Masjid Taha]] and the [[Islamic Centre Jamiyah]].<ref name="Tradisi Johor">{{cite web|url=http://www.bharian.com.my/articles/MasjidlamadiSingapuramasihkekaltradisiJohor/Article/|title=Masjid lama di Singapura masih kekal tradisi Johor|date=19 February 2012|website=[[Berita Harian (Malaysia)|Berita Harian]]|trans-title = Old mosque in Singapore still retains Johor tradition|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120219132736/http://www.bharian.com.my/articles/MasjidlamadiSingapuramasihkekaltradisiJohor/Article/|archive-date=19 February 2012}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Mohammed |first=Ahmad |date=7 April 1981 |title=Telok Blangah kaya dengan kesan-kesan sejarah |trans-title=Telok Blangah is rich in historical traces |url=https://eresources.nlb.gov.sg/newspapers/digitised/article/beritaharian19810407-1.2.45 |work=Berita Harian |pages=5}}</ref> Generally, mosques in Singapore adhere to [[Sunni Islam]]; the only exception is [[Masjid Burhani]], which is affiliated with the [[Dawoodi Bohras]], a sect of [[Shia Islam]].<ref>{{Cite journal |date=January 2023 |title=Shi’i Communities in Southeast Asia: Religious Harmony Institutions and Peaceful Sunni-Shia Relations in Singapore |journal=Journal for the Study of Islamic History and Culture |volume=4 |issue=1 |pages=4–5 |eissn=2722-8975}}</ref>

Two more mosques in [[Tampines]] and [[Choa Chu Kang]] have been planned for the early 2030s.<ref>{{Cite news |date=4 March 2025 |title=Tengah to get new mosque, Tampines North mosque to resume construction in 2027: PM Wong |url=https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/tengah-to-get-new-mosque-tampines-north-mosque-to-resume-construction-in-2027-pm-wong |access-date=3 March 2026 |work=The Straits Times |language=en |issn=0585-3923|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260720005009/https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/tengah-to-get-new-mosque-tampines-north-mosque-to-resume-construction-in-2027-pm-wong|archive-date=20 July 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Plans for new mosque development |url=https://www.mccy.gov.sg/about-us/news-and-resources/plans-for-new-mosque-development/ |access-date=3 March 2026 |website=Ministry of Culture, Community & Youth |language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260614075212/https://www.mccy.gov.sg/about-us/news-and-resources/plans-for-new-mosque-development/|archive-date=14 June 2026}}</ref>
